actionAdapters.when: 当前只能从 Framework 文档识别已实现 Action；MCP describe/plan/execute 均不可用，可信审批与 allowlist 完成前返回 blocked

allow: confirmed project-local Bundles output for the selected Package and version
documented YooAsset build cache and temporary output
deny: unrelated Package, version or generated output
CDN, object storage, cache purge and any remote write
store upload, Git commit or push, and UPM publish

requiredFor: 覆盖已有同 Package 同版本输出
改变 BundledCopy 集合或覆盖 StreamingAssets 产物
delete, external write, credential use, Git commit or push
confirmation.rule: 确认绑定 Target、PackageName、BuildVersion、固定输出根和完整构建选项；任一输入改变后旧确认失效。

evidence: 冻结的 Target、PackageName、BuildVersion 与 AssetBundleBuildArgs
本次输出目录及 YooAsset 构建报告
未执行 CDN、商店、Git 与 UPM 发布的边界说明
